visualCharacteristics.purpose: FAQ list of collapsible question/answer items with dividers and plus icons
visualCharacteristics.description: Plain FAQ list with dividers and plus icons, max width 10 cols

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = question: a heading (H3 recommended, kept inside the summary) or plain text; cell 2 = answer content (paragraphs/lists)

usage.description: Use for FAQ sections below a "Questions? We have answers." heading.

reuseGuidance: Reuse for any collapsible Q&A list.
